wwox_observation: Pyramidal neurons: Rin +40 percent, rest +4 to +6 mV, absolute sag and KO-only rebound larger (Table 1, PMID34634460). Rin up with a depolarised rest is what fewer open K+/leak channels give; extra open HCN would lower Rin.
mechanism_and_missing_bridge: Recruitment: sag and rebound are enlarged mainly because the same current step drives a more resistive, more depolarised cell about 8 mV further and about 4-5 mV more negative, while HCN density and gating are unchanged. Missing bridge: no voltage-clamp Ih and no matched-excursion current clamp exists in any WWOX preparation.
probe_or_qualified_compound: None needed for the first step (protocol only). To identify the conductance later: XE991-sensitive current (Kv7) kept apart from non-Kv7 leak; ZD7288 as tool, see probes.tsv (P01).
action_cell_context: Layer II/III pyramidal neurons in slices of neuron-deleted mice and littermates; cell level; ex vivo.
competing_alternative: (a) more HCN conductance; (b) different HCN gating or distribution; (c) HCN plus K+ plus T-type together; (d) an excitation-dependent compensation. Not mutually exclusive.
favourable_result: At matched starting potential and matched peak excursion the genotypes show the same sag (current clamp) and the same Ih amplitude and V1/2 (voltage clamp), while Rin and rest still differ.
weakening_result: At matched potential KO keeps a larger sag or Ih (then HY3 opens), or a ZD7288-insensitive component carries the difference.
next_decision: Run experiment.tsv X1-X3. If HY1 holds, put the K+/leak identity (Kv7 versus other leak) ahead of any HCN lever; if it fails, go to HY2/HY3.
label: IPOTESI

wwox_observation: Bursts in the same slices need NMDAR activity (prior package); KO neurons show larger rebound, which can convert an inhibitory event into excitation.
mechanism_and_missing_bridge: Sag/rebound (HCN, with a T-type component) shapes the cell response that starts or spreads bursts; direction of benefit unknown: block may lower bursts, leave them, or worsen them (Ih also shunts EPSPs, PMID33547341; ZD7288 enhanced 4-AP events, cited in PMID34634460). Missing bridge: no WWOX slice has been exposed to an Ih blocker.
probe_or_qualified_compound: ZD7288 (tool; sodium-channel block documented in DRG neurons, PMID22989944) with a second structurally different Ih blocker; nickel/Z944 for the T-type arm kept separate (ttype package); Kv7 arm separate (existing lead).
action_cell_context: Ex vivo bursting slices, layer II/III, P13-17; cell effect (sag, rebound, Rin, Vrest, firing) read first, then burst frequency and propagation, in the same slices.
competing_alternative: Burst change follows the NMDAR dependence and not the Ih block; or block lowers bursts only through a Rin/Vrest side effect; or sodium-channel block explains it.
favourable_result: ZD7288 removes sag with engagement shown (sag gone, Rin and Vrest reported), a second blocker agrees, and bursts fall without lowering evoked fEPSP in WT or collapsing AP height.
weakening_result: Sag removed but bursts unchanged (support for HCN in sag, no benefit); bursts worse (not by itself compensation: off-target and compartment must be examined); no engagement (no conclusion).
next_decision: Decide after X4-X5: continue to isoform/compartment work, to a Kv7 arm, or stop the HCN line at the cell level.
label: IPOTESI

wwox_observation: No WWOX datum on HCN amount, gating, surface expression or distribution exists. Nothing links WWOX to filamin A, TRIP8b or membrane lipid domains in neural cells (queries Q01-Q09).
mechanism_and_missing_bridge: Nested origin of one phenomenon: if Ih itself differs (HY1 fails), the change could be in channel number, surface fraction, subunit or TRIP8b isoform, subcellular position (PMID33547341: sag rose without total HCN1 change), FLNa-type scaffolding (PMID24403084) or lipid environment (PMID39548079, DRG HCN2, little effect on HCN1). These are alternatives to one another, not three confirmations. Missing bridge: any WWOX-deficient neuron measurement of surface HCN1/HCN2 and TRIP8b isoforms, or of membrane order.
probe_or_qualified_compound: Read-outs, not drugs: surface biotinylation or immunolabelling of HCN1/HCN2; TRIP8b isoform RT-PCR; CTxB FLIM-FRET for domain size. The HCN1-FLNa decoy with scrambled control (PMID24403084) as a trafficking tool only. No lipid supplementation is proposed.
action_cell_context: Cortical neurons of neuron-deleted mice and littermates (and cultured neurons if slices fail); subcellular compartments reported separately (soma, proximal and distal dendrite).
competing_alternative: (i) recruitment only (HY1); (ii) an HCN-independent K+/leak change; (iii) T-type changes alone for the rebound.
favourable_result: Voltage clamp shows a different Ih V1/2, slope, kinetics or surface fraction in KO at matched conditions.
weakening_result: Ih identical at matched conditions (HY3 closes); or a difference appears only in the total, with no surface or compartment difference.
next_decision: Open only if X2 shows an Ih difference. Then X6 (surface/compartment) before any trafficking or lipid line; the lipid read-out only if surface and gating disagree.
label: IPOTESI
